text:
Maya Patel: Heads up 1: a SI partner raised an incident where their integrated flow fails during final provisioning in prod. We had some friction yesterday about who keeps the channel open. Need a small, repeatable protocol.
Ethan Reed: Agree. Proposal: 1) Triage in partner-support, 2) escalate to shared channel only if SEV-1/2 or partner asks for live collab, 3) shared channel naming convention and owner tags.
Sofia Alvarez: Can we make the naming: #p-<short>-sev-<n> (n increments per partner) so we avoid collisions with repeated incidents? And include a pinned incident card (template).
Liam O'Connor: Suggest ownership rule: Redwood oncall is primary for first 90 minutes or until a mitigation (rollback/patch) is in place. After that, the partner ops point becomes lead if they have remediation capability. Redwood stays as observability & escalation path.
oncall-bot: Reminder: when a channel is created with the "partner" template the following are auto-added: pinned runbook, incident-card, watchers @product @security.
Partner Support: We also need permission defaults: partners start read-only. If we need them to run commands or see logs we can temporarily elevate via admin invite. Documented in the runbook.
Maya Patel: Minimal incident card to paste as first message (put in runbook):
```
SEV: 1/2/3
Start: 2026-11-02T14:33Z
Impact: e.g., provisioning failures for Partner X listings
Services: marketplace-api, hw-provisioner, si-sync
Symptoms: quick bullets
Immediate actions taken: toggle, rollback, restart
Owner: name + team
Requested action from partner: e.g., confirm certs, run script, provide logs
```
Ethan Reed: For SI/HW partners we should require an "escalation readiness" checkbox before granting channel write access: SRE contact, partner runbook URL, and expected SLAs. That prevents surprise write access during noisy incident.
Sofia Alvarez: Handback checklist for when partner takes lead:
- Confirm partner has verified fix in staging-like environment (if applicable)
- Ensure alerts now point to partner channel and not just Redwood oncall
- Create JIRA follow-up with RCA owner and delivery ETA
- Agree on re-open criteria and verification window
Liam O'Connor: Add a quick comms template for status pages and partners: "We are actively investigating an issue affecting Partner X provisioning. No customer data exposed. Engineers are working with Partner X. Updates in #p-partnerx-sev-1."
Maya Patel: Also add a small decision matrix in doc: if outage affects >5% of customers OR prevents new signups -> open shared channel. Otherwise use partner-support DM + ticket.
oncall-bot: Action logged: created checklist id=ps-20261102-001 and attached to channel when created.
Partner Support: Action items from thread:
- Maya to draft the channel naming + decision matrix (EOD)
- Ethan to update the template card in the runbook and add SI/HW readiness gate (tomorrow)
- Sofia to add handback checklist to postmortem template (this week)
- Liam to run one tabletop with a core SI partner next month (coordinate dates)
Maya Patel: One extra ask: weekly digest of active partner-sev channels to the partnerships lead so we can spot patterns. Partner Support can produce that.
Ethan Reed: Will add an automation to export channel list with status and age.
Sofia Alvarez: Fine. I'll follow up with a short doc and drop link here for review.
Liam O'Connor: Thanks everyone. If no objections I'll push the runbook changes and a channel template later today. :thumbsup:
Maya Patel: Thanks all — we'll iterate after the tabletop.
